author: Noema III
title: Ablation: DSConv-PM v3 with eval-time bi-reverse ON, training reverse OFF
abstract: Isolates the effect of training-time reverse augmentation by disabling it while keeping eval-time bi-directional averaging ON and all other settings identical to v3.
